run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:21:42Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by real error spans at frontend-proxy and by 500 responses in its access log, but frontend-proxy is the aggregation point, not the origin. The burst (00:23:30-00:25:30 samples: ingress and 'router frontend egress' error-status span rate ~0.41-0.50/s versus a ~0-0.01/s blip baseline) is entirely on the checkout path: frontend 'POST /api/checkout' / client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error ~0.44/s with its success rate at 0, checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge error ~0.43/s while payment's own 'charge' span rate fell to 0 for the 00:24-00:26 samples, and frontend-proxy logged repeated 'POST /api/checkout 500 via_upstream'. The payment Deployment was at revision 2 after a pod-template-only rollout restart (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:21:55Z, same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment); the old pod was killed at 00:22:00 and the new container only logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 00:23:16.791Z, first charge at 00:24:03.991Z. ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config currently holds two enabled fault-injection settings aimed exactly at this dependency - paymentUnreachable defaultVariant 'on' ('Payment service is unavailable') and paymentFailure defaultVariant '100%' - while every other flag is 'off'; by the stated rule for such settings the ConfigMap is named as the root cause, with the payment restart and the checkout/frontend/frontend-proxy errors as mechanism and consequences. The conclusion is partial: no change history exists to show when those flags were switched, no object explains why the payment Deployment was rolled at 00:21:55, the declared 100% charge-failure fault is contradicted by continuous successful charges logged from 00:24:03, and the errors stopped while both flags are still non-off.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error-status span rate rose from ~0 to 0.4778/s ('router frontend egress') and 0.4889/s ('ingress') at the 00:23:30 sample and stayed at 0.41-0.47/s through the 00:25:30 sample, versus 0/s at the 00:22:00-00:23:00 samples and ~0.0111/s blips earlier.

During that burst the frontend service's 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and client span 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' were STATUS_CODE_ERROR at ~0.44/s, and their non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) rate fell to 0 at the 00:24:00 and 00:25:00 samples.

In the checkout service the client span 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' and the server span 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' both carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.4333/s in the 00:25:00 sample, while checkout's CartService/GetCart, CurrencyService/Convert and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans carried no error status in the same query.

frontend-proxy's access log records repeated 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' responses, e.g. at 00:23:07.101Z, 00:23:24.990Z, 00:23:45.279Z and 00:24:02.401Z, plus '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' on GET /api/data at 00:24:46.297Z and 00:26:29.361Z.

The payment service's own 'charge' span rate was 0 at the 00:24:00, 00:25:00 and 00:26:00 samples (0.631 at 00:23:00, 0.478 at 00:27:00) and no payment span carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR in the returned samples, i.e. no charge spans were reported by payment during the burst.

Deployment payment is at deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2: ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (created 2026-11-17T23:50:00Z, revision 1) and ReplicaSet payment-79d86bf97f (created 2026-11-18T00:21:55Z, revision 2) whose pod template differs only by annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:21:55Z; both use container image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment with identical env.

Namespace otel-demo events show Deployment payment scaling ReplicaSet payment-79d86bf97f from 0 to 1 at 00:21:55Z and payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0 at 00:22:00Z, pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 'Stopping container payment' at 00:22:00Z, and the replacement pod's container Started at 00:21:59Z with image 'ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment' already present on the node.

The replacement payment container payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 00:23:16.791Z, its first 'Charge request received.' at 00:24:03.991Z, and one line '14 UNAVAILABLE: Connection dropped' at 00:24:12.851Z.

Every charge request payment logged from 00:24:03 through 00:26:55 was followed by 'Transaction complete.' (e.g. continuous pairs 00:25:53.937Z-00:26:55.009Z and 00:24:05.091Z-00:24:28.829Z); no charge-failure line other than the single 14 UNAVAILABLE line appears in those reads.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) contains fault-injection flag 'paymentFailure' with defaultVariant "100%", variants {10%:0.1, 100%:1, 25%:0.25, 50%:0.5, 75%:0.75, 90%:0.95, off:0}, state ENABLED, description 'Fail payment service charge requests n%'.
The same ConfigMap contains fault-injection flag 'paymentUnreachable' with defaultVariant "on", variants {off:false, on:true}, state ENABLED, description 'Payment service is unavailable'.

All other flags in demo.flagd.json (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) have defaultVariant "off"; paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable are the only two non-off settings.

At query time pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-b9w85 (start 2026-11-17T23:49:59Z) and pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t (start 2026-11-18T00:21:55Z) were both phase Running with all conditions Ready=True and container restartCount 0.

Service payment is a ClusterIP on 100.67.64.85:8080 with selector opentelemetry.io/name=payment, and its Endpoints object has the single ready address payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t (100.96.2.170) port 8080.

checkout's own logs for 00:23:48-00:24:56 show '[PlaceOrder]' requests being completed with 'payment went through', 'order placed' and 'order confirmation email sent', i.e. some orders succeeded inside the burst window.

Outside the checkout path no other dependency showed error spans in the burst: frontend's client spans to CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, AdService/GetAds and RecommendationService/ListRecommendations had no STATUS_CODE_ERROR samples between 00:20:00 and 00:35:00.

frontend-proxy 'ingress' error-status spans stayed above the burst baseline after recovery: 0.0131/s at 00:34:00 and 0.0333/s at 00:34:30 and 00:35:00, while 'router frontend egress' error rate was 0 at those samples and no downstream service reported errors then.

The two enabled payment-targeted settings in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config are the fault source: 'paymentUnreachable'="on" matches the observed shape (checkout's PaymentService/Charge client spans errored while payment reported no charge spans for 00:24-00:26 samples), and 'paymentFailure'="100%" targets the same charge operation; the payment Deployment restart at 00:21:55 is then the mechanism that made the change take effect.

Alternatively the burst is explained purely by the payment rollout: with replicas=1 the Service had no serving backend between the old pod's termination at 00:22:00 and the new gRPC server's start at 00:23:16.791, which would produce checkout Charge errors and frontend 500s on /api/checkout for that interval. This remains a candidate because the flag values were read only after the incident.

'paymentFailure'="100%" taken literally is contradicted by payment's own logs: every charge it received from 00:24:03 to 00:26:55 logged both 'Charge request received.' and 'Transaction complete.', and checkout logged 'payment went through' throughout 00:24, so all-or-nothing charge failure was not in effect during those minutes.

Both payment flags were still non-off in the ConfigMap read at about 00:45, yet frontend-proxy error-status spans returned to the 0.01-0.03/s background level by the 00:26:00-00:28:00 samples and the burst did not recur through 00:33:30, so the settings alone do not explain the start/stop timing.

frontend-proxy itself being the faulty component was considered and rejected: its pod had restartCount 0 and Ready=True, its access log shows it proxied to upstream 'frontend' (via_upstream) and relayed frontend's 500s rather than generating upstream failures, and the same burst appears in frontend and checkout spans beneath it.

The isolated 0.0111/s frontend-proxy error blips that precede the burst (00:20:30, 00:22:00, 00:22:30 samples) were considered as the whole explanation and rejected: they are about one error span per 2-minute window, they also occur later (00:34:30-00:35:00, 0.0131-0.0333/s) with zero egress errors, and they are an order of magnitude below the 0.44/s burst.

Compare the intended state of ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable) with the change record around 2026-11-18T00:21Z and confirm whether the payment Deployment rollout restart at 00:21:55 was part of that same change; if the payment fault flags are not intended, return them to 'off'/'0'.

Make payment restarts non-disruptive for this single-replica Service: add a startup/readiness gate and minReadySeconds so traffic is not sent before the payment gRPC server is listening (observed container start 00:21:59Z versus 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 00:23:16.791Z).

gaps: No change-history integration is available (change_history not integrated), so when flagd-config's paymentFailure/paymentUnreachable were switched on, and what triggered the payment Deployment rollout restart (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:21:55Z), cannot be established.

Jaeger returned no traces for 00:20:00-00:30:00 (traces_search for frontend-proxy, checkout and frontend all empty); the trace sample that did return covers only about 00:13:24.9-00:13:25.4, so gRPC error codes/messages of the failing checkout->payment calls are unknown.
list_prometheus_rules returned no rules both with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and unfiltered, so the alert's expression, threshold and evaluation timing are unknown.
app_payment_transactions_total returned no series in the 00:10-00:35 window (and no labels for it), so payment transaction success/failure counts are unknown; a missing series is not zero.

The Kubernetes objects read are point-in-time at about 00:45; the payment Service/Endpoints and ConfigMap state during 00:21-00:27 is not directly observed, and the deleted pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4's logs are unavailable, so whether it served charges up to its 00:22:00 termination is unknown.

A kubernetes_jq_query for networkpolicies in otel-demo returned no objects; that shows only that this query matched nothing, so a network-level cause for the payment unreachability cannot be confirmed or excluded.
The residual frontend-proxy ingress-only error blips at 00:34:00-00:35:00 (0.0131-0.0333/s, zero egress errors, no downstream service errors) have no identified source in the evidence.

A checkout log query for error/failure text over 00:21:00-00:28:00 returned no matching lines (view status no_data), and the frontend container produced no log lines at all in 00:22:00-00:27:00, so checkout/frontend error text for the failed orders is unknown.

The burst was observed only through 2-minute-rate samples and access-log lines whose internal timestamps are offset; exact start/end alignment between the 500s, the checkout span errors and the payment restart is within a couple of minutes, not exact.
